name: kimi-k2-thinking
description: moonshotai/Kimi-K2-Thinking exactly as its Hugging Face config.json (main). The campaign's `kimi` workload variant (the local MMLU traces are from Kimi-K2-Thinking).

attention.notes: MLA: the cache holds the compressed latent (kv_lora_rank 512) plus the decoupled rope key (64), bf16: 1152 B per layer per token, replicated on every TP rank (vLLM); 61 layers = 70,272 B per token. head_dim above is v_head_dim; q/k per-head width is qk_nope_head_dim + qk_rope_head_dim.

moe.notes: first_k_dense_replace 1: layers 0..0 are dense (intermediate_size 18432); 60 MoE layers with 384 routed experts of width 2048 plus 1 shared expert; num_nextn_predict_layers 0 (MTP module, not part of the serving forward pass here). HF config stores the checkpoint's quantization_config (fp8 / int4 weights); the campaign runs bf16 shapes, torch_dtype bfloat16.
